content.comment_body: I have a [product_name] [article_no], [product_name] v[version_no] and [product_name] v[version_no]. I created a button using the Digital Value component from the component panels in the [product_name] software. My variable settings are: - Block Type: Q. - Block Number: Q1. - Writable: enabled. - Page downloaded to the [product_name] (with SD card). Currently, the button does not operate any outputs Q1 through Q4. Changing the web browser does not resolve the issue. However, physical outputs Q1 to Q4 function when I1 to I4 are connected to them and tested. Although the instructions on creating a webservice with a button seem straightforward, I am unsure what I am missing.
A digital output can be controlled remotely (for instance, via a webserver) only if it is not connected on the left side (input of the output) to any logic in your program.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter confusion when trying to operate digital outputs via a web interface using the Digital Value component. The output buttons do not perform as anticipated, despite proper configuration in logic and hardware. Although available guidance is considered clear, the actual implementation may not match user expectations, creating a disconnect between intended actions in the web interface and physical output behavior.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that assigning a Digital Value button to a digital output in the web editor should enable direct remote switching of the output.
pain_keywords: lack of clear feedback between logic/program and web control
